_comment: Bridge between ARCHV player slugs and API-Football's own numeric player ids. Only read by
scripts/shared/providers/api-football.mjs, which is not the shipped provider.
This starts empty on purpose. Resolving a name to an id costs one request out of a daily
budget of 100, so the ids get looked up once, by hand, and committed. Fill an entry like this:
"line": "A third Golden Boot in four seasons in England."
Haaland's id below was resolved on 2026-08-04 by GET /players/profiles?search=haaland, which
returned 1100 for E. Haaland (Norway). Look the rest up the same way, one request each, and
commit what comes back. Five names are still outstanding: bruno-fernandes, jimenez, anderson,
Remember what the key can see: seasons 2022 to 2024 only. The current season stays on the
hand-checked static roster, so this map exists for back seasons and for the day the plan is
